## HAPI v0.25.3.2

Compared with the previous maintained release, [`v0.25.3.1`](https://github.com/swear01/hapi/releases/tag/v0.25.3.1), this hotfix declares the Web markdown renderer's `react-markdown` import as a direct dependency and removes lock-layout dependence that could surface missing `remark-stringify`, mdast, vfile, and hast types during a clean full typecheck.

Compared with the official release, [`v0.25.3`](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/releases/tag/v0.25.3), it retains the complete v0.25.3.1 upstream PR and personal-fork feature set.
